title: The Cars That Built the World
description:
S01 E01 — Fueling Invention
Frustrated by the limitations of personal transportation, rival engineers Carl Benz and Gottlieb Daimler set out to liberate humanity from their dependence on the horse by harnessing the power of the internal combustion engine.

title: The Cars That Built the World
description:
S01 E02 — Create a Market, Build an Empire
As the car becomes more than a curiosity, early carmakers gain traction with their inventions. The outbreak of World War One catapults the industry into a new era of competition, paving the way for a new generation of engineers.

title: The Cars That Built the World
description:
S01 E03 — Motorize the Masses
As the roaring twenties bring cars to the masses in America, Europe lags far behind, and Japan struggles to modernize. The car could be the answer to the problems of both nations - until World War II changes everything.

title: The Cars That Built the World
description:
S01 E04 — Winning the World Over
As America enters a golden age of car design, German and Japanese carmakers struggle to recover from the devastation of World War II.

Danny is hired to restore a 1966 Mustang Convertible, then discovers there's not a whole lot of car between the bumpers; a classic Packard is in need of some tender loving care; enhanced.

title: Modern Marvels
description:
S19 E01 — Adventure Machines
Adrenaline runs high when Adam Richman visits the factory where Yamaha makes ATVs, WaveRunners and more; an inside look at a company built to get people sky-high in paramotors; amusement park Diggerland USA; mech-suits; submarine built for two.

title: Modern Marvels
description:
S19 E02 — Heavy Machinery
Adam learns the true meaning of heavy when he visits legendary heavy equipment manufacturer: John Deere; big machines do big jobs, and he gets an inside look at how top brands like SANY and JCB are pushing the envelope on what these machines can do.

title: Modern Marvels: WWII
description:
S01 E03 — Gear and Gadgets
In this episode, necessity sparks wartime ingenuity, turning compact tools into powerful weapons. From the Bazooka and Cavity Magnetron radar, to the Enigma code machine, to a pioneering night vision scope, engineers and scientists create faster.

title: Modern Marvels: WWII
description:
S01 E01 — Super Weapons
From Britain's Bouncing Bomb and Grand Slam, to America's B-29 Superfortress, and Germany's massive Gustav Gun, these innovations shatter defenses, dominate the skies, and lay the groundwork for modern military technology.

title: Modern Marvels: WWII
description:
S01 E02 — Mega Builds
From blasting through mountains, to building gigantic infrastructure across the sea, to the biggest battleship in history and iconic builds like the Pentagon and the Maginot Line, WWII engineering is a battle of scale that turns the tide of the war.

title: The UnBelievable With Dan Aykroyd
description:
S01 E05 — Outlandish Inventions
Looking at outlandish inventions; a full-body gas mask for babies; Smell-o-Vision; a robot powered by eating slugs; inflatable airplanes; hidden cameras in contact lenses; coffin security systems.

title: The UnBelievable With Dan Aykroyd
description:
S02 E03 — Fantastic Beings
Exploring the stories of the planet's fantastic beings.

title: The UnBelievable With Dan Aykroyd
description:
S03 E02 — Freak Accidents
Accidents happen all the time, but every so often, a few defy logic and leave the world stunned; from a man blasted by a high-pressure air hose, to a lumberjack who survived near decapitation, they border on the impossible.

title: The UnBelievable With Dan Aykroyd
description:
S02 E04 — Unusual Places
A city where the commute requires a zipline; a town crawling with monkeys; a waterfall of blood.

title: The UnBelievable With Dan Aykroyd
description:
S01 E06 — Superhumans
A blind man who uses bat-like powers of echolocation to navigate his surroundings; a samurai with reflexes faster than a speeding bullet; a man who's immune to electrocution.

title: The UnBelievable With Dan Aykroyd
description:
S02 E20 — Curious Crimes
A robber successfully snatching Einstein's brain; a thief who makes out with hundreds of dollars all while dressed as Santa Claus; these are some of history's most curious crimes.

title: The UnBelievable With Dan Aykroyd
description:
S02 E19 — Strange Afflictions
A trip to the doctor is sure to cure any afflicted individual, but what happens when even the doctors are stunned by what they see?; from a family cursed with blue skin, to a girl allergic to the world's most unlimited resource and more.

title: The UnBelievable With Dan Aykroyd
description:
S03 E08 — Unusual Pastimes
These are the stories of history's most unusual pastimes, some fascinating, some dangerous, but each of them completely unbelievable.

title: The UnBelievable With Dan Aykroyd
description:
S02 E12 — Extraordinary Journeys
From a dog's space voyage, to a harrowing story of Arctic survival, to various trips through time; journeys so extraordinary that they are truly unbelievable.

title: The UnBelievable With Dan Aykroyd
description:
S02 E08 — Unconventional Weapons
People has heard the tales of wars fought with groundbreaking weaponry; learning about everything else in between; from missiles manned by pigeons to an incendiary device made to look like one of America's favorite pastimes.

title: The UnBelievable With Dan Aykroyd
description:
S03 E06 — Outlandish Ideas
From a coastal cleanup plan that ends with an earth-shaking surprise, to a fugitive's fiery fix for an unexpected problem, these are the real-life moments when people thought way outside the box.

title: The UnBelievable With Dan Aykroyd
description:
S03 E05 — Man vs. Nature
Mother Nature doesn't always play nice, whether it's a mile-long sinkhole, a biblical swarm of crop-killing grasshoppers or an invasion of rum-fueled monkeys running wild on the island of St. Kitts; stories where humans go head-to-head with nature.

S01 E01 — Death of the Old Rules
Follows the American Mafia from their early development in New York City neighborhoods; how public violence, involvement in the drug trade, and appearances at government hearings affect their operations and conflict with their code of honor.

title: American Godfathers: The Five Families

S01 E02 — Rise of the New Dons
Focusing on the conflict between the families' old guard and a new generation of younger, American-born, mobsters willing to defy the authority of the bosses and the long-established rules in order to fulfill their own ambitions.

title: American Godfathers: The Five Families

How a more aggressive commitment by law enforcement to eradicate the mafia forces the families to find creative ways to stay in business and out of jail; it's not as easy as it's been in the past and some are willing to throw it all away.

title: History's Greatest Mysteries
description:

On Christmas morning in 1945, five siblings vanish from their family home in West Virginia during a raging fire; despite the work of dozens of investigators and thousands of amateur sleuths, the mystery remains.

title: History's Greatest Mysteries
description:

In 2016, a mysterious illness strikes dozens of government officials in Cuba; hundreds more are afflicted.

title: History's Greatest Mysteries
description:

A perfectly masterminded plot leads to one of the most brazen prison breaks in American history; with only a handful of clues left behind, the search for the infamous Alcatraz escapees continues to this day.

title: History's Greatest Mysteries
description:
S05 E12 — The Sinking of the Titanic
The Titanic's tragic story captures the imagination of the public and experts of all kinds, who, decades after the ship's demise, still seek answers; a look into new evidence that might reveal more about how and why the Titanic sank.
